views.rationale: Revenue fell $1.936 billion YoY and operating margin slipped to 20.1% from 33.3% indicating weaker near‑term performance
Declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.18 per share and repurchased 101 million shares, reducing equity by $3.5 billion
First‑quarter sales rose 12% to $11.887 billion and operating profit margin improved to 15.3% from 13.2% YoY
Net income dropped to $1.38 billion ($0.72 per share) from $3.60 billion ($1.93 per share) year over year
worldwide sales rose 7.9% to $22.3 bn, driven by 5.5% operational growth and 2.4% currency impact
investment banking fees jumped 59% to $2.97 bn and principal transactions surged 121% to $6.5 bn in Q1 2021
sales in away‑from‑home channels were significantly negatively affected by COVID‑19 restrictions, reducing overall product sales
Revenue grew 84% YoY to $5,661M from $3,080M, with segment revenues up 81% and 88%
